definition.title: Black-Hole / Relativity Lab
definition.summary: Deterministic Schwarzschild landmark and static-clock teaching model for an ideal non-rotating, uncharged black hole.
assumptions: The exterior spacetime is exactly Schwarzschild: isolated, spherical, non-rotating, and uncharged.
Mass input is an IAU nominal-solar GM ratio, not a measured SI mass in kilograms.
The selected observer is static at fixed Schwarzschild areal radius and therefore must be accelerated to hover.
The far-away comparison uses the asymptotic Schwarzschild time/frequency reference.
The radial coordinate is areal radius, not proper radial distance from a center.
limitations: No Kerr spin, charge, frame dragging, ergosphere, or observed-source fitting.
No ray tracing, lensing/shadow prediction, accretion disk, Doppler beaming, or photographic black-hole appearance.
No free-fall or orbital integration, hovering acceleration, tidal-force, or Shapiro-delay calculation.
No merger/gravitational-wave, Hawking-radiation, formation/evolution, singularity, or quantum-gravity model.
The landmark schematic is a geometric teaching representation, not a direct observation or proper-distance map.

equations.meaning: Convert IAU nominal-solar mass scale q to gravitational parameter.
Static shell-clock rate relative to asymptotic Schwarzschild time.
Infinity-referenced frequency ratio and gravitational redshift for a static source.

landmark_definitions.label: Event horizon
landmark_definitions.interpretation: Event-horizon areal radius for the ideal Schwarzschild black hole.

landmark_definitions.label: Photon sphere
landmark_definitions.interpretation: Unstable circular null-geodesic radius in Schwarzschild geometry.

landmark_definitions.label: ISCO
landmark_definitions.interpretation: Innermost stable circular timelike-geodesic radius in Schwarzschild geometry.

validation_fixtures.purpose: Require the exact IAU/NIST q=1 radius to agree with OpenStax rounded 2.95e3 m.
Check the q=10, r=2R_s default against exact sqrt(1/2) clock/redshift arithmetic.
Require horizon/photon-sphere/ISCO radii at exactly 1, 1.5, and 3 R_s.
Check physical landmark radii and mu scale linearly with nominal-solar GM input.
Check clock/redshift factors are mass-independent at fixed R_s multiple.
Check the 1.01R_s lower product bound remains finite and exterior.
Check the 100R_s upper product bound remains finite and tends toward the asymptotic reference.
Check all meter-scale outputs remain finite at q=1e10.
Reject booleans, non-finite values, and states outside either public bound.
Require repeated model evaluations to be value-identical.
Reject changed sources, constants, landmarks, preset, validation identity, and duplicate JSON keys.

scientific_validation.method: Cross-check the q=1 Schwarzschild radius against the independently rounded OpenStax solar example, then test exact IAU/NIST constants, landmark ratios, static-clock/redshift relations, all public bounds, mass scaling, dimensionless radius invariance, determinism, and strict artifact mutation rejection.
